text: Civil law issues of Smart Contracts: Focusing on the DAO case presents the following source proposition: 이 글에서는 특히 이더리움 기반의 DAO(Decentralized Autonomous Organization) 사건의 경위를 소개하고 분석함으로써, 이러한 문제점들을 발굴하고 부각하고자 하였다. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that A decentralized autonomous organization is merely computer code with no directors, managers or employees, its governance structure built with software, code and smart contracts running on a public decentralized blockchain platform. The proposed response is an extension: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
